items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: So somebody, they begged me and begged me. Edgar, he's in Chicago now. They were short of a man that played a fume.

ctx.x: What about brass bands? What was the first brass band you ever played with?

Who me? I haven't played, well, yes, I played two parades in New Orleans since I've been a musician. I played on Labor Day. I played with Sam and Chris Kelly. They was playing a brass band. Playing a parade. And they fooled me. And I didn't want to go and play. And they asked me to play. And I played from Louisiana Avenue down to Connell Street. And them cats was laying down on them, you know. And they want to open up when they got over Connell Street, you see. And when they did get over Connell Street, Kelly…
What did Ed Gunn play, one instrument? The drum. Is that Bat's brother? Yeah. Ed Gunn Moses. Yeah.
